about: 2.7.0.9166 (2015-06-15): Swipe and Explosive Shot deal all their damage before on-damage triggers (the target's first, then the others' in reverse order); Shadow of Nothing no longer destroys itself; I Am Murloc's Murloc costs 0; Leokk and Sunwalker reworded; the translations of build 9166 (mostly Italian).
